entry.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: How natively multimodal embeddings work

media:group.media:title: EmbeddingGemma 2: How natively multimodal embeddings work
media:group.media:description:
Learn how EmbeddingGemma 2, Google's open, lightweight multimodal embedding model, maps text, code, images, video, and audio into a single, unified embedding space.
The video covers: * How modality-specific encoders and a bidirectional transformer turn multimodal data into a single representation. * The two-stage training recipe: initializing from Gemma 4 and distilling from Gemini Embedding 2, then finetuning with contrastive and spread-out losses. * Efficiency techniques for running in resource-constrained environments.
Have questions? Drop them in the comments.
